claude-code-tresor: claude-code-tresor claude-code-tresor  alireza rezvani (alirezarezvani) alirezarezvani/claude-code-tresor a development-workflow kit of skill, agent, subagent, and slash-command documents copied into a claude code configuration directory. 8 skill.md skill directories under skills/ in three categories (development, documentation, security), 8 core agent definitions carried both as agents/<name>.md and as subagents/core/<name>/agent.md, 133 agent.md subagent definitions under subagents/ across ten category directories, 24 slash-command directories under commands/ in eight categories, and 6 prompt templates, 11 standards documents, and 10 worked examples under prompts/, standards/, and examples/. scripts/install.sh clones the repository into ~/.claude/tresor and installs from that copy into the host's discovery locations: each skills/<category>/<skill> directory holding a skill.md is flattened into ~/.claude/skills/<skill>; each commands/<category>/<name> directory is copied to ~/.claude/commands/<category>-<name>; each subagents/core/<name>/agent.md is rewritten into a flat ~/.claude/agents/<name>.md with the frontmatter fields claude code does not support stripped; the whole subagents/ tree is copied to ~/.claude/subagents/; and prompts/, standards/, examples/, readme.md, and contributing.md are copied to ~/.claude/tresor-resources/, which the script also names in the ~/.claude/tresor.config.json it writes. the readme's manual path differs: it copies agents/ rather than subagents/core/ into ~/.claude/agents/, installs no subagents, and puts the reference documents in ~/claude-code-resources/ instead. owns no state it reads back and does no enforced work: everything installed is markdown that claude code reads and executes with its own tools, and the only code it ships copies those files into the host's discovery directories.
